description: Na₂MnPHO₃F₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form distorted NaO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₂F₄ octahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₃F tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 58°. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.65 Å. There are two shorter (2.24 Å) and two longer (2.57 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to five F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.78 Å. Mn is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form MnO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MnO₂F₄ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent PO₃F tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-58°. Both Mn-O bond lengths are 2.19 Å. There are two shorter (2.09 Å) and two longer (2.20 Å) Mn-F bond lengths. P is bonded to three O and one F atom to form PO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₂F₄ octahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-64°. There are two shorter (1.50 Å) and one longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond length. The P-F bond length is 1.63 Å. H is bonded in a linear geometry to one O and one F atom. The H-O bond length is 1.04 Å. The H-F bond length is 1.44 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one P, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Mn and one P atom. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Mn, and one H atom to form distorted FNaMn₂H tetrahedra that share corners with six FNaMn₂H tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FNa₃Mn tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the third F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Mn tetrahedra.
